title: COMPLETING MISSING ANNOTATION: MULTI-AGENT DEBATE FOR ACCURATE AND SCALABLE RELEVANCE ASSESSMENT FOR IR BENCHMARKS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the proportion of unlabeled relevant chunks (Hole@10) across 25 different retrieval systems and calculating the growth rate and marginal contribution to demonstrate how missing annotations in benchmarks systematically underestimate the performance of advanced retrievers.

Comparing the relevance labeling tendencies of different LLM families (e.g., Llama vs. Qwen) to detect model-specific predispositions (e.g., leaning toward predicting 'relevant' vs. 'irrelevant') and evaluating how multi-agent debate mitigates this single-perspective bias.
